text:
alexa: Quick one — UX wants a lightweight 'preview sandbox' for saved queries in Console analytics: let users run a query against a sampled window to see routing decisions, quota/cost preview, and model breakdown before saving or rollouts. thinking about API + UX tradeoffs. anyone blocked by infra?
sam: Nice. Two immediate Qs: 1) scope — personal vs route vs org? 2) should preview run full telemetry or a sample? full could spike cost.
maria: Prefer sampled telemetry for speed and cost. Also: RBAC — previews mustn't reveal other teams' private route configs. suggest default scope=personal and explicit scope param for team/route with permission checks.
alexa: Agreed on default personal. UX: show a small 'estimated cost' card and a latency histogram. If scoped to route, label it clearly and require owner confirmation.
pj: API sketch: ```POST /api/console/query_preview { "query": "...", "scope": "personal|route|team", "sample_window": "1h|24h|7d" } -> 200 { "est_tokens": 1234, "est_latency_ms": 220, "routing_decisions": [ {"route":"route-A","model":"rwd-13b-q","weight":0.8} ] }``` We can reuse eval infra but must ensure it doesn't increment usage counters.
sam: +1 on not incrementing usage. Let's return estimates only, no token billing, and mark preview runs in telemetry as synthetic. Also: throttling — previews should have a rate cap per-user to avoid abuse.
maria: Implementation note: use a sampling flag in the query-exec pipeline so kernels select shorter sequence lengths and fast kernels; and return a confidence interval for cost estimate. UI can show "~1234 tokens ±10%".
nora: Ops concern: route-level previews could expose fallback routing policies (e.g., dedicated vs hosted routing). Need to sanitize any internal fallback hints before returning. Maybe preview returns only the effective model choices and not internal tier reasons.
alexa: Good catch. Proposal: preview returns model choices, estimated split, and cost/latency estimates; hide policy reasons and show a link "view routing policy (redacted)" that opens docs.
pj: For the API contract, add header X-RW-SANDBOX: true so internal systems can short-circuit billing and sampling. Also include X-RW-PREVIEW-ID in responses for debugging.
sam: Who owns this? alexa + pj for API + UX, maria for telemetry sampling, nora for privacy gating. Can we target a small prototype in next sprint?
alexa: I'll carve a spike — will mock UI and wire the API stub. plan: 1) spike (3d) 2) infra proto (5d) 3) UX polish (2d). tagging: @maria @pj @nora.
deploy-bot: scheduled-retrofit: preview-proto branch created and CI run queued. :rocket:
sam: tiny follow-up — add rate-limit headers in the response so the Console can show how many previews left for the minute.
alexa: Yep, will include X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining in the prototype. ok to proceed? :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
